basis: dev set, 16 images, 98 damages, report_dev_v3.json. Thresholds are the dev results rounded down; per TZ section 11 they are not set above what was reached on dev.
notes: Pilot sample: with 16 dev and 24 test images the metrics are noisy; a difference of a few points between dev and test is within noise.
Severity, part and action labels come from one annotator so far; the second independent pass is pending.
Results below the targets do not by themselves mean failure (TZ section 11); they must be reported and explained.
